tools.name: search_credit_unions
tools.description: Find US credit unions by name, trade name (e.g. "SECU", "BECU"), city or NCUA charter number. Returns matches largest first, with charter numbers to pass to the other tools.

tools.name: get_credit_union
tools.description: Full profile of one credit union from its latest NCUA call report: address, phone, charter, every ratio (capital, earnings, loan quality, growth, lending and deposit mix, loan rates) with national and peer-group percentiles, five quarters of history and offices.

tools.name: compare_credit_unions
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 6 credit unions on chosen metrics (default: size, growth, capital, earnings, loan quality, fees and loan rates).

tools.name: rank_credit_unions
tools.description: Rank credit unions on any metric (e.g. largest by assets, highest return on assets, lowest new auto loan rate, best capitalized), nationally or within a state, peer group or asset range. Ratio rankings exclude very small credit unions by default (each metric has a minimum asset size).

tools.name: peer_report
tools.description: How one credit union compares with its peers on every ratio that has a better direction: value, peer median, percentile, and its clearest strengths and weaknesses. Peers = its NCUA asset-size group nationally, every credit union in its state, or its asset-size group within its state.

tools.name: state_summary
tools.description: Credit unions headquartered in one state: count, combined assets, members and loans, delinquency, medians of key ratios and the largest credit unions.

tools.name: find_offices
tools.description: Credit union branch offices in a city, ZIP code or county (or every office of one credit union in a state), from NCUA's branch file: address, phone, hours, drive-through and ATM. Use for "credit unions near <place>" questions.

tools.name: best_credit_unions
tools.description: The best credit unions in a state (including those headquartered elsewhere with offices there) or nationally, scored only from NCUA call-report data: deposit dividends, loan rates, fees, strength and member growth, each a percentile against same-size peers. Use for "best credit union in <state>" que

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: Every metric key the other tools accept, with its definition, unit and which direction is better.
